scope: local RV64 IFU and LSU page-table walker PTE 8B S-mode WRITE PMP decision, checker-address-to-AW binding, independent AXI AW/W handshakes, access-fault response through handshake, A/D update allow path and registered transaction ownership; downstream IFU lane owner and tval propagation remain in IFU-ACCESS-G1 and IFU-TVAL-G1

results.expected_marker: T4F IFU deny returns response
results.name: ifu_bypass_write_deny_branch
results.purpose: Ignore a qualified IFU PTE WRITE deny and enter the A-update path.

results.expected_marker: T4F IFU PTE WRITE PMP denies
results.name: ifu_disable_write_request
results.purpose: Remove the WRITE bit from the IFU PTE update PMP query.

results.expected_marker: T4F IFU denied PTE emits no AW
results.name: ifu_expose_aw_on_deny
results.purpose: Incorrectly expose AXI AWVALID in the IFU PTE WRITE deny decision cycle.

results.expected_marker: T4F IFU denied PTE emits no W
results.name: ifu_expose_w_on_deny
results.purpose: Incorrectly expose AXI WVALID in the IFU PTE WRITE deny decision cycle.

results.expected_marker: V9K IFU allow enters A-update
results.name: ifu_force_deny_granted_write
results.purpose: Treat every IFU A-update as denied even when the WRITE checker grants.

results.expected_marker: V9K IFU allow AWADDR equals checked PTE address
results.name: ifu_offset_ad_update_awaddr
results.purpose: Drive the IFU A-bit update AWADDR one PTE beyond the physical address checked by PMP.

results.expected_marker: T4F IFU PTE WRITE PMP denies
results.name: ifu_query_final_exec_pa
results.purpose: Query the translated instruction PA instead of the registered PTE address.

results.expected_marker: T4F IFU PTE WRITE PMP denies
results.name: ifu_query_machine_privilege
results.purpose: Use M-mode instead of the S-mode implicit page-table access privilege.

results.expected_marker: T4F IFU deny returns access fault
results.name: ifu_report_page_fault_for_write_deny
results.purpose: Return instruction page fault instead of instruction access fault for a PTE WRITE deny.

results.expected_marker: V9K IFU 8B partial-cover PTE WRITE denies
results.name: ifu_shrink_pte_write_to_4b
results.purpose: Check only 4B of the 8B PTE write.

results.expected_marker: pending AW was withdrawn before fire
results.name: ifu_withdraw_aw_after_w_handshake
results.purpose: Withdraw the pending IFU PTE AW channel after the independent W handshake.

results.expected_marker: V9K IFU AW-first keeps W pending
results.name: ifu_withdraw_w_after_aw_handshake
results.purpose: Withdraw the pending IFU PTE W channel after the independent AW handshake.
